[#reference-checks]
== Checks, suites and generators

Every check runs through `agora check [SECTION...]`. With nothing named it runs every section; `--suite` runs a named set, `--scope` limits a section to one resource, and `--changed` runs only the sections whose watched files changed. A section that cannot run says why and is skipped, never passed, and the run exits 3. `agora help check` says which to run before you push.

=== Generators

A generator writes tracked files from their sources. `agora fresh` proves each current and writes nothing; when one is stale it names the command that rewrites it.

[cols="1,3,2,2"]
|===
|Generator |What it writes |Rewritten by |Files

|`agent-skill`
|The agent skill, .claude/skills/agora/SKILL.md, from the registry (0041-command-line FR-037)
|`agora skill generate`
|`.claude/skills/agora/SKILL.md`

|`brand-decoration`
|A brand's decoration kit: the traced lockup and icon, the set wordmark and unit marks, and their measured finest detail in tokens.json
|`agora decoration generate`
|`design-systems/*/logos/vector/**`, `design-systems/*/logos/units/**`, `design-systems/*/tokens.json`

|`brand-imagery`
|A brand's WebP files, share card, app icons and favicon, from its masters and tokens
|`agora imagery build`
|`design-systems/*/imagery/web/**`, `design-systems/*/images/share-card.png`, `design-systems/*/images/favicon.ico`, `design-systems/*/images/icons/**`

|`brand-specimen`
|A brand's assurance specimen, from its tokens.json
|`agora brand generate`
|`design-systems/*/assurance/fixtures/specimen.html`

|`brand-theme`
|A brand's brand.css and brand.tex, from its tokens.json
|`agora brand generate`
|`design-systems/*/brand.css`, `design-systems/*/brand.tex`

|`openedx-sources`
|A brand's Open edX package sources (everything but the built dist/), from its tokens.json, logos and fonts
|`agora openedx generate`
|`design-systems/*/openedx/**`

|`print-layout-docs`
|The print design system's layout and typeface catalogs inside its Markdown, from latex/layouts.json and latex/typefaces.json
|
|`design-systems/frontiers-print/docs/*.md`

|`profile-figure`
|The organization profile's figure: its semantic source and the themed default and on-dark images
|`agora figure generate`
|`profile/figures/*.svg`

|`reference-docs`
|The guide's reference chapters: commands, checks, help topics, toolchain, design systems and specs
|`agora docs generate`
|`docs-src/chapters/reference/*.adoc`

|===
